rapier v

Write docs, keep notes, draw and paint. Everything you make is plain Markdown. Fast, offline, free. Phone-first: Made for your phone, works anywhere with a browser.

Now or in 20 years.

get rapier

  • The Rapier app for Android. No internet permission. Nothing leaves your phone. This is the best way to use Rapier.
  • rapier.website in any browser. On a phone, tap Add to home screen and it opens like an app, offline too.
  • Rapier for Windows (beta).
  • Rapier for Linux (beta). It follows your Omarchy theme.
  • With Claude, ChatGPT, Grok Bot, Muse or any agent that speaks MCP. Add Rapier as a connector and say "open Rapier". It puts the page in front of you and works on it with you.

Tip⁠Drag the circle at the right edge to fly through a long document, or tap it to see the headings.
